title: Registering new SQL migrations in OSSMigrations and migration_ids.txt
answers: Where do I register a new database migration in Grafana?
Why is a newly added SQL migration failing migration tests in testdata/migration_ids.txt?
How to hook up a new ualert migration in sqlstore migrations?
body:
Mechanism: SQL migration runner registration in OSSMigrations and migration ID tracking list.
When defining new database migrations in pkg/services/sqlstore/migrations/ualert/alert_rule_missing_series_evals_to_resolve.go:ExpandAlertRuleMissingSeriesEvalsToResolve, the migration function must be called in pkg/services/sqlstore/migrations/migrations.go:OSSMigrations.AddMigration.
What breaks if skipped: Each migration ID must also be listed in pkg/services/sqlstore/migrations/testdata/migration_ids.txt; omitting either prevents migrations from running or fails migration regression tests.
